items.title: Land aircraft spatial truth
items.exit_criteria: The full local corpus reports terminal accounting, zero false bindings and no published error above 500 m.

items.title: Land deterministic multisensor replay
items.exit_criteria: Replay schemas, adapters and byte-identical receipts are validated with terminal checks.

items.title: Land isolated-clone runtime
items.exit_criteria: Main installs, tests and packages without a sibling TheHub checkout.

items.title: Disposition rescued OCR patches
items.exit_criteria: Each patch and local artifact is retained, superseded or rejected; obsolete places.geojson is not promoted.

items.title: Replace obsolete gazetteer dependency and supply geo anchors
items.exit_criteria: Geocoding and anchor seeding run from tracked provenance-bound inputs with fail-closed zero-key behavior.

items.title: Execute real FR24 production export
items.exit_criteria: Production mode rejects synthetic rows, validates a real capture package and flips live readiness only with receipt evidence.

items.title: Port terrain imagery and enrichment layers
items.exit_criteria: GEBCO, imagery, ILAP and optional enrichment layers are ported with independent provenance and no mission or intent inference.

items.title: Certify SG0 before later skill-governance phases
items.exit_criteria: SG0 is certified on exact head; SG1-SG4 remain separately authorized and non-inherited.
